tool.name: ChronAeon Dynamics
tool.description: Estimate epidemic growth rate (r) and reproduction numbers (R0, Rt)
tool.command: #if $input_file: ln -s '$input_file' input.$input_file.extension && #end if #if $input_tree: ln -s '$input_tree' input.nwk && #end if chronaeon dynamics #if $input_file: --alignment input.$input_file.extension #end if #if $input_tree: --tree input.nwk #end if #if $metadata: --metadata '$metadata' ## data_column params store a 1-based column INDEX, but the ## chronaeon CLI expects a column NAME. Resolve index -> name. #if $date_col: --date-col "\$(head -n1 '$metadata' | tr '\t' ',' | cut -d',' -f$date_col)" #end if #if $strain_col: --strain-col "\$(head -n1 '$metadata' | tr '\t' ',' | cut -d',' -f$strain_col)" #end if #end if #if $pathogen: --pathogen '$pathogen' #end if #if $generation_time: --generation-time $generation_time #end if #if $generation_sd: --generation-sd $generation_sd #end if #if $latent_time: --latent-time $latent_time #end if --units '$units' #if $mu_prior: --mu-prior $mu_prior #end if --window-size $window_size --step-size $step_size #if $plot: --plot --plot-path chronaeon_dynamics_plot.png #end if @OUTPUTS@

param.name: input_file
param.label: Input alignment
param.help: FASTA alignment with dates in headers. Provide this and/or a tree — at least one is required.

param.name: input_tree
param.label: Phylogenetic tree
param.help: Newick tree with calibrated or substitution branch lengths. Provide this and/or an alignment — at least one is required.

param.label: Generation time
param.help: Mean clinical generation interval / serial interval in days (default from pathogen preset or 5.0)

param.label: Generation SD
param.help: Standard deviation of clinical generation interval

param.label: Latent time
param.help: Optional latent period in days for SEIR renewal model

param.label: Time units
param.help: Time units for generation interval parameters

param.label: Date column
param.help: Metadata column for sample collection date

param.label: Strain column
param.help: Metadata column for taxon / strain identifier

param.label: Clock rate prior
param.help: Substitutions/site/year to convert substitution trees to calendar time

param.label: R(t) window size (years)
param.help: Window span in years for dynamic R(t) skyline

param.label: R(t) step size (years)
param.help: Step size in years for sliding window

tool.help:
ChronAeon Dynamics: Epidemic Growth Rate & Reproduction Number Estimation ============================================================================
**What question does this method answer?**
What is the epidemic growth rate (r) and basic/effective reproduction number (R0/Rt) for a heterochronous sample of pathogen sequences?
**How it works**
ChronAeon Dynamics extracts coalescent intervals from a time-calibrated tree, estimates the exponential growth rate via profile likelihood, and converts to R0/Rt using pathogen-specific generation interval presets or user-supplied parameters. A sliding-window R(t) skyline captures time-varying reproduction.
**Inputs**
- A FASTA alignment (with dates in headers) or a Newick tree - Optional metadata CSV/TSV with collection dates - Optional pathogen preset (h1n1, ebola, sars-cov-2, measles, hiv_early)
**Outputs**
- **JSON**: growth rate (r), R0, R(t) skyline, confidence intervals - **CSV**: dynamic R(t) skyline time series - **Plot (PNG)**: optional 3-panel diagnostic figure
